en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from someone else, from Sahl Bin Ziiyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Hammad Bin isa, from Hareyz, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘For Allahazwj there is an Angel who records the extravagance in the Ablution (Wudhu) just as he records his (other) transgressions’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ali ibn Muhammad and others have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Shammun from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Allah has an angel who writes down one’s acting excessively or transgressing limits.’”
